purpose: Color palette specification board for elderly AI companion device
prompt:
Professional industrial design color palette specification board for an elderly AI companion device.

Layout: Clean horizontal palette board on warm cream background (#F5F0E8). Show 8 large color swatches arranged in a row with generous spacing. Each swatch is a rounded rectangle (minimum 80x120px) with the color fill and hex code + name below it.

Color swatches from left to right:
1. surface-cream #F5F0E8 — "Primary Surface" — warm cream fabric
2. surface-warm-gray #D4CFC7 — "Secondary Surface" — soft-touch plastic
3. accent-wood #C4A882 — "Accent" — light oak wood
4. glow-amber #E8B87A — "Functional" — warm LED light
5. text-charcoal #3D3832 — "Text" — warm black text
6. soft-sage #A8B5A0 — "Accent Secondary" — calm indicator
7. highlight-white #FAFAF7 — "Highlight" — clean highlights
8. shadow-warm #8A8279 — "Shadow" — warm shadow tone

Below the swatches: a "Contrast Rules" section showing three small diagrams:
- Text contrast: text-charcoal on surface-cream = 10.2:1 (WCAG AAA)
- Button contrast: surface-warm-gray on surface-cream = 5:1 minimum
- LED visibility: glow-amber on surface-cream = soft but visible

Bottom annotation: "All colors below 30% saturation — warm neutral palette, no cool blues or pure whites"

Style: professional design specification board, schematic layout, humanist sans-serif typography (Source Sans Pro style), generous whitespace, warm tones throughout. No decorative elements. Clean, technical, editorial. Kinfolk magazine aesthetic meets industrial design spec sheet.
